scope: Escape marks an active DM/group conversation read through scoped latest-message lookup and exact-anchor server read APIs. DM metadata refresh and group read revisions preserve newer unread state and detached history.

Shared modal boundaries prevent keyboard and direct conversation commands from navigating or mutating background conversations while a menu/dialog is open. Shortcut help may still toggle its own dialog.

Group upload shortcut invokes the existing file input only when composing is available. Validated selections append to existing attachments, cap at ten and preserve content/reply. Oversize rejections use the shared rejection feedback.
Group search reset on a new scroll target derives from request identity rather than synchronously setting React state inside the scrolling effect.
